Designed for Apple Intelligence. -------------------------------------------- Mac Studio. **The ultimate pro desktop** with phenomenal performance from the **M4 Max chip**. Compact and quiet, Mac Studio packs massive memory, breathtaking graphics, unprecedented AI capabilities, and ultra-fast Thunderbolt 5 ports. Designed for Apple Intelligence. * POWERED BY M4 MAX OR M3 ULTRA — Tackle the most demanding workflows, from detailed visual effects to 3D animation and film scoring. The power of the Neural Engine enables AI for complex tasks, and the advanced GPU architecture supports dynamic caching, mesh shading, and ray tracing. * EXCEPTIONAL MEMORY AND STORAGE – Enjoy up to 128GB of unified memory and up to 8TB of storage with the M4 Max chip, or up to 512GB of unified memory and up to 16TB of storage with the M3 Ultra chip. * DESIGNED FOR APPLE INTELLIGENCE – Apple Intelligence is the personal intelligence system that helps you write, express yourself and do more effortlessly. With revolutionary privacy technologies, you can be confident that no one can access your data, not even Apple. * THE PERFECT SIZE FOR YOUR DESK – With its compact 19.7-centimetre square enclosure, Mac Studio fits perfectly under most displays. * SILENCE IN THE STUDIO – The thermal system is designed to allow Mac Studio to handle the most demanding tasks in a flash while remaining silent, so it doesn't interfere with your workflow. * HIGHLY CONNECTED PERFORMANCE – Mac Studio features up to six Thunderbolt 5 ports, two USB-A ports, an HDMI port, an SDXC card reader, and a headphone jack. Connect up to five external displays with the M4 Max and up to eight with the M3 Ultra. * YOUR PRO APPS TAKE OFF — Enjoy tens of thousands of apps, including powerful pro and AI-powered apps like DaVinci Resolve Studio, Final Cut Pro, and Adobe Photoshop. * IF YOU LOVE THE iPhone, YOU'LL LOVE THE Mac — The Mac works beautifully with your other Apple devices. Copy something from your iPhone and paste it on your Mac. Chat in Messages or use your Mac to make or receive FaceTime calls.   **Legal** 1 Apple Intelligence is available in beta on all Mac models with an M1 chip (and later models), with Siri language and device language set to English (South Africa, Australia, Canada, United States, Ireland, New Zealand, and United Kingdom), as part of a macOS Sequoia update. Additional features and the following languages will be available in early April: German, English (India, Singapore), Chinese (Simplified), Korean, Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese, and Portuguese (Brazil). Other languages, including Vietnamese, will follow later this year. Feature availability may vary by region and language. 2 1 GB = 1 billion bytes and 1 TB = 1 trillion bytes; actual formatted capacity is less. 3 Apps available on the App Store.
